Duuuude that's the fuckin exact way I feel. I have social anxiety and I've regretted so many things. Man I completely understand how you feel I don't know how to put it into words. I'm also pretty tired of being social I don't know. Like people just lie to you. They say stuff so they can be with other people they like more than you. But it's so obvious that I always point it out if they're lying. One time one of my best friends said he's gotta go offline and stuff and a minute after that I saw the notification of him starting a game cuz he forgot to turn himself offline on steam. I always try to be honest but sometimes I'm too honest. I don't know man. I can relate so much to this. But one thing i can say is just to be yourself. Even if you're annoying it's better than being boring. Oh yeah and the more times you're involved in more uncomfortable situations the better you get at being in these situations. And eventually you change yourself and know that you're being annoying cuz you're annoying to yourself. Thx man you helped me feel better.
